_README: Triage of every separator-shaped assertion in this repo — an asserted string literal containing '/' compared with in/not in/== (L-51). Keys are '<file>::<literal>' so they survive line moves. 'platform' means the right-hand side is a real filesystem path and the assertion is a platform claim that must be fixed; 'message' means the slash is guaranteed on every OS and why. Generated from a real AST scan; see tests/test_separator_claims.py.

tests/test_onboard_candidates.py::docs/A.why: spec_candidates returns paths as p.relative_to(root).as_posix() — an engine-composed POSIX string, not an OS-rendered path — so these compare an as_posix() value against a posix literal and are byte-identical on Windows.
